environment.description: Same NestJS microservice on EKS v1.27 in namespace 'webhooks-prod'. Calico CNI with GlobalNetworkPolicy 'default.deny-metadata' applying to pods matching label app=webhook-svc. Policy spec: order 100, selector 'app == "webhook-svc"', egress rule denying destination nets [169.254.169.254/32] on all ports with action Deny. Additionally, a namespace-scoped NetworkPolicy 'restrict-egress' with podSelector matchLabels app: webhook-svc, policyTypes [Egress], egress rules allowing DNS (UDP 53 to kube-system) and HTTPS (443) to external CIDR 0.0.0.0/0 EXCEPT 169.254.0.0/16 and 10.0.0.0/8. Node IMDS configured with HttpTokens: required (IMDSv2) and hop limit 1 (container cannot reach IMDS even if network allows it due to extra network hop through container bridge).
